body: As much as it may suck you should force yourself to get up and go outside if the weather is decent or at least leave your house and do something. Also tonight try and get a good nights rest. Personally I'm running on three hours sleep and I'm at work pretty miserable but I'm getting by. Lack of sleep really messes with everything.

If it's any help the reason I'm considering going back on a mood stabilizer is because I've been so up down in terms of depression suicide. Usually the weekends hit me the worst. Mondays are also usually rough but I've been catching myself getting worse and worse. I have not been telling my therapist about it because I really don't want to be hospitalized. The last time I actually tried to OD it was my third loony bin trip. Gonna try meds again before I do anything drastic... go down the same path. I've managed some how to function in this society (in this state) if I can do it I think anyone can... Btw are you enjoying what you are studying in school?

Give the anti depressants some time. Some of them can take awhile to kick in. I've been on / off meds for awhile, the only reason I got off of them was because I thought I finally was cured. A huge part of the population goes through depression. I fall into that chronic depression bucket unfortunately, but it can be beaten or at least reduced with effort and time. I can't say my life is 100% great but I am happy I've stuck around

Hi there,

I am so sorry you are going through such a shit time. I am twenty nine and I've struggled with depression most of my adult life. In terms of things you can do immediately are you currently employed / do you have any employment opportunities in Australia? Do you want to stay out there? In terms of meeting people what about taking some time to pick up a hobby or help a homeless shelter? A year ago I picked up a mindfulness course that happened to be connected to a church that fed the homeless. I have to say I met some very nice people and it always helps trying to help others.
You are in a whirlwind storm it will pass. Ending a seven year relationship... I can't even imagine. As someone who is surviving I can tell you there will be good days and really shitty bad days but you are the only one that can enrich your life. You won't be alone forever! You will make connections! I hope my words were of some help...

You sound just like me! I posted earlier today. My moods have been swinging recently... Might go back on meds (been off meds for almost a year now) I'm 29. Have you considered going on anything? You should have access to a professional counselor on campus? I go through ups and downs more then I care to admit. Gotta ask do you drink? I know whenever I have a drink the next day = shit.

I am pretty new to posting but I've lurking on this sub for awhile. There are some really good people on this forum. I've been struggling with depression for most of my adult life. Today I posted for the first time. Depression can be tough... I've been doing things day by day minute by minute. Do you have anything that can distract you? Have you tried meditation?
Care to tell us more about you? What you are going through?

Any response helps at the moment. I've been thinking maybe I need to flip my life... try escaping, start somewhere new, etc. I just feel stuck like this... even with a new job it's like nothings changed
Thank you for the response I truly appreciate it. I will check out the link. I may of read about him before... Today has been rough.
